rationale: The response stays fully in bass-fishing tournament metaphor throughout and maps key Court mechanics precisely (nine anglers, certiorari as lure applications, Rule of Four as tying on a lure, briefs as fishing logs). Voice remains committed and evocative without reverting to plain prose.
quote: The U.S. Supreme Court is the ultimate bass-fishing tournament, the one with the biggest payout and the heaviest trophy, held on a secretive, fog-shrouded lake that only nine anglers are ever allowed to fish at one time.
